COMMERCE · PROJECT

Agentic customer experiences for travel

Earning the next booking by making this trip easier.

Has anybody already built an agent that plans the whole trip, not just the booking?

THE PROJECT · 11 SCREENS

The question

Why do AI demos keep coming back to travel, and what would actually earn a traveller’s loyalty?

The approach

Treat a trip as a chain of decisions. Learn the combination of likes and dislikes for this trip, remember where someone has been and how they feel about going back, carry each choice into the next stage, and reach them on the right channel at the right moment.

The tradeoff

Personal context makes suggestions far better, but it must be earned and used at the right time rather than all at once.

What to take with you

Labels like “beach buff” are a start; the combination of preferences is what describes a traveller.
